thread.subject: Re: Renewal of the Meridian MSA [NWT-COM-0311]

message.text:
Further to our exchange, we are content with the renewal term but not with the indexation mechanic in clause 12.3. We propose CPI capped at 4% per annum rather than the uncapped RPI figure.

Please confirm whether Northwind can accept that, and we will countersign this week.

Regards,
Meridian Supply Group — Legal
